svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four. Cut 581 mm lengths of 32 mm tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Squash the last 75 mm of each end flat in a vice (about 50 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wide, 5 mm thick), both ends flat in the same plane.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend each flat end 45 degrees, 45 mm from the end, the two ends

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bent opposite ways so they end up square to each other.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The bend points are 491 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower end: one 11 mm hole, 22 mm from the end, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper end: one 9 mm hole, 22 mm from the end, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Zinc-rich paint where the galvanizing cracked in the vice.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lower end flat on the post's inner side face, its bend 350 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below the beam (M10 through the post); upper end flat under the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: beam, its bend 350 mm in from the post (M8 into a rivet nut).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lying on the post and beam, both flat ends sit flat.
